parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: performs a dry run without publishing route entries. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.

- **false** (default): sends a normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the resource status is queried.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouteEntries
parameters.description: The list of route entries to publish. You can specify up to 50 routes.

sub_parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
sub_parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the route entry.

sub_parameters.name: RouteTableId
sub_parameters.description: The route table ID of the route entry.

parameters.name: TargetInstanceId
parameters.description: The publish route entry target instance ID.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description: The type of the route publish target.
